skills.trigger: When evaluating a chest X-ray for suspected posterior mediastinal pathology or paraspinal abnormalities.
steps: Trace the right and left paraspinal lines from the thoracic inlet down to the diaphragm to assess their continuity and symmetry.
Identify any focal increase in density or widening in the lower mediastinum that causes lateral displacement or obliteration of these lines.
Distinguish unilateral displacement (suggestive of neurogenic tumors) from bilateral displacement or diffuse widening (suggestive of lymphoma or other systemic processes).
